description: Functional refactoring suggestions (light bulb quick fixes) for F#, built on FSharp.Analyzers.SDK. Over 180 rules covering correctness, performance, idiom and redundancy. Suggestions are Hint severity and never gate a build; the priority rules show as warnings in the editor.
releaseNotes:
0.8.52: One build, for FSharp.Analyzers.SDK 0.41 (FsAutoComplete 0.86+, Ionide 8+, fsharp-analyzers 0.41), in analyzers/dotnet/fs; the SDK 0.37 and 0.35 builds are gone, and 0.8.51 is the last release for older hosts.

 0.8.51:A build for FSharp.Analyzers.SDK 0.41 (FsAutoComplete 0.86, Ionide 8, fsharp-analyzers 0.41), and one folder per build: analyzers/dotnet/fs (0.41), fs-sdk0.37, fs-sdk0.35. Point an editor at analyzers/dotnet and the CLI at the folder for its version. The package declares no dependency: FSharp.Compiler.Service and the analyzer SDK landed in the bin of applications referencing it. Prose such as "types generated by JsonProvider" no longer marks a file generated.

 0.8.50: FR0029's return hoist no longer takes the `elif` links after an awaiting arm as a branch of their own: it put `return` in front of the `elif` keyword, which didn't compile, and the build check rolled the edit back.

 0.8.49: FR0016 and FR0070 read what takes reference types only (a value, a record literal or a type argument given to it), in the project's other files and, under --api-changes, the projects referencing the type: [<Struct>] stopped TryAddSingleton compiling.

 0.8.48: New rules FR0183, and FR0184 (off by default): secrets and clients a redirect exposes. New rule FR0185 (off by default): unions with no fields can be structs. FR0016, FR0070, FR0130, FR0131, FR0011, FR0033, FR0026 and FR0132 read past harmless attributes. FR0118 leaves shared and detached work, comparisons and overloads with another return type alone; FR0152 ignores unrelated removals.

 0.8.47: FR0066 resolves a query text's names to the binding in scope and folds constants (holes, `+`, sprintf and String.Format of constants, `Module.name`), read where the text was built: a per-member `let baseQuery = "..."` is no finding. Loaded code (an analyzer, source generator, MSBuild task or a driver's finalizer) crashing on a background thread no longer ends the run: reported once, the run goes on and exits 1; out of memory and the tool's own failures still stop it.

 0.8.46: FR0182 checks a lambda's pattern parameter against the lambda's body and stays quiet where the scope holds an `#if`. A test file is also recognised by a qualified or non-first test attribute; FR0092 finds a C# test pinning a failure message and leaves the message alone.
